stem:
Read these lines from the poem.

Before I joined the great stampede,
I thought: What will stampeders need?
Now I'm a Dawson millionaire!
I sell them ALL long underwear.

Which sentence from the selection best matches an idea presented in these lines?

options.label: A
options.text: During 1898 some $10 million in gold was found in the Yukon.

options.label: B
options.text: Thousands of businesspeople came to Seattle ready to offer goods and services to the prospectors.

options.label: C
options.text: This marked the beginning of the Klondike gold rush.

options.label: D
options.text: The Seattle Chamber of Commerce moved quickly to take advantage of this upswing in the economy.
